title: Suite Escape | KEY.co
description_expanded: Suite Escape, nestled in Seacrest Beach, Florida, offers an enchanting retreat perfect for families and groups seeking a luxurious coastal getaway. This charming three-bedroom, three-bathroom beach home is thoughtfully designed to provide all the comforts of home amidst the stunning beauty of the 30A area. The spacious living area invites relaxation with its large smart TV and queen sleeper sofa, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar makes meal preparation a breeze. The dining area provides a cozy space for sharing meals and creating memories. The home features two king bedrooms, each with a smart TV, the primary bedroom boasting an en suite bathroom, and a third bedroom with a queen bed and bunk bed, comfortably accommodating up to four guests. Located in the picturesque Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, Suite Escape offers the perfect blend of modern amenities and natural beauty. The large screened-in porch provides a serene spot to unwind, while the nearby Beach Access at Gulf Lakes offers easy entry to the pristine shores that make 30A so renowned. Guests can explore the charming neighborhood by walking or biking to local attractions. After a day at the beach, the resort-style pool, set amidst the community’s natural wooded beauty, offers a refreshing retreat. Magnolia Cottages by the Sea promises an idyllic escape where families can forge lasting memories against the backdrop of a picturesque coastal haven, making it the ideal choice for your next beach vacation.
